decisions.choice: Local-only implementation; no hosting registration or publishing
decisions.reason: Explicit specification constraint

decisions.choice: Project-local Node 24 and pnpm 10 bootstrap
decisions.reason: Host has Node 22.23.1 and pnpm 12.4.2; avoid changing global tools

decisions.choice: Mock UI is a separate Vite mode. Real mode must fail closed until Worker integration is verified.
decisions.reason: Never expose fixture holdings as observed funds

decisions.choice: Accessible navy/mint dashboard; system fonts, Radix dialogs, Tailwind 4, Lucide
decisions.reason: Specified product design; variance 3, motion 2, density 5

decisions.choice: @fastify/static 10.1.11; glob 14.0.2 and minimatch 11.0.1 overrides for affected transitive ranges
decisions.reason: Audit found high/moderate path traversal and glob denial of service advisories; patched versions installed and verified

decisions.choice: vite-plugin-wasm 3.6.0, no strict-peer-dependency exception
decisions.reason: 3.5.0 does not support Vite 8; install failed closed with ERR_PNPM_PEER_DEP_ISSUES. 3.6.0 supports selected Vite major.

decisions.choice: Vite build mode wallet-local maps to application data mode local
decisions.reason: Vite reserves the literal mode name local for .env.local handling; build initially failed with a precise conflict error.

decisions.choice: Worker ready handshake before host requests; bundled WASM with CSP wasm-unsafe-eval only
decisions.reason: Browser tests found initial postMessage loss during top-level WASM initialization. Handshake fixed the observed startup race; ordinary unsafe-eval remains prohibited.

decisions.choice: Solidity 0.8.38 with evmVersion paris, OpenZeppelin 5.6.1
decisions.reason: Solidity 0.8.19–0.8.37 are affected by the Yul optimizer knowledge-base stale-bookkeeping bug. The specification explicitly permits a fixed 0.8.x compiler.

decisions.choice: OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.4.0 for Paris-compatible standard assets; Solidity 0.8.38 unchanged
decisions.reason: Compiling the tested 5.6.1 dependency failed because Arrays.sol/Bytes.sol require Cancun MCOPY. The 5.4.0 standard-asset dependency graph avoids those functions and includes the published Bytes lastIndexOf security fix. No dependency source is patched and the target remains paris.

decisions.choice: Use the full observed Devnet genesis hash and a real container IPv4 bind address for Agave 4.4.1
decisions.reason: Actual probes rejected a truncated Devnet identity. Agave 4.4.1 panicked on 0.0.0.0 with UnspecifiedIpAddr; the entrypoint now binds its container IPv4, while only loopback RPC ports are published.

decisions.choice: Metaplex program built from pinned commit with dependency-only Cargo lock updates
decisions.reason: Rust 1.95 removed stdsimd and rejects old wasm-bindgen; program source unchanged. Exact lockfile, tool and ELF hashes recorded in infra/metaplex-build.json.

decisions.choice: Token-2022 extension-free mints permit ImmutableOwner on their canonical ATA
decisions.reason: The Associated Token Program adds ImmutableOwner to Token-2022 accounts. It does not alter transfer amounts; all other account extensions remain blocked. Rent is estimated for 170 bytes.

decisions.choice: Solana browser tests use a disposable validator in ewallet-browser-test
decisions.reason: Independent ledger and fixed localhost18899 endpoint; no named volumes; cleanup never touches ewallet-demo state.

decisions.choice: Private browser assertions use boolean polling
decisions.reason: Playwright 1.65 locator failures attach DOM snapshots independently of PLAYWRIGHT_NO_COPY_PROMPT. tests/helpers/private-expect.ts avoids that matcher path; screenshots, video and tracing remain disabled.

decisions.choice: RPC and session quotas use separate groups
decisions.reason: Real transaction preparation and balance polling exhausted the shared global quota. Bounded read/RPC limits are 2400/minute; session creation remains 10/minute.

decisions.choice: Solana messages include an explicit public request-marker Memo
decisions.reason: A unique reviewed Memo prevents identical repeated transfers in one blockhash window from yielding the same deterministic signature. Only a random public UUID is included. https://www.solana-program.com/docs/memo

decisions.choice: Web popup connector with retained read-only connection window
decisions.reason: Exact source/origin/channel/request binding, challenge acknowledgement and immutable Worker reviews. Closing/locking/revoking clears SDK accounts; each signature opens a new independent unlock session.

decisions.choice: Bounded SQLite indexing with public watch heartbeats
decisions.reason: Atomic event/cursor/snapshot commits, durable signature pagination, inclusion-hash rollback, exponential retry backoff and global upstream concurrency 3. Inactive watches poll at 30 seconds and pause after 90 seconds without public-data activity.

decisions.choice: Updated Polygon Amoy endpoint and complete Base fee oracle
decisions.reason: Polygon retired its original public RPC in July 2026; use the currently documented dRPC endpoint. Base fees use actual L1 upper-bound/operator oracle reads, rechecked reserves and observed receipt extras. References in README.

decisions.choice: Hardhat legacy Zod source security backport
decisions.reason: Hardhat 3.22 requires the Zod 3 API. Backport early size-bound rejection in CJS/ESM/TS, test live parsers and contract behavior, rebuild node image. audit:verified exempts only the checksum/behavior-verified CVE-2023-54404 patch; unfiltered audit evidence is retained.

decisions.choice: Vault fixture assertions follow chain maturity
decisions.reason: Initial locks naturally mature. Seed reruns remain idempotent and verify original durations/principal; browser refusal tests create a fresh real one-hour deposit.

decisions.choice: Public execution remains blocked by free faucet funding
decisions.reason: Eight public RPC identities were independently verified. Random testnet-only identities are unfunded; Devnet airdrop was unavailable/rate limited. Preserve blocked_funding results and public funding addresses; no paid tokens or false success.

decisions.choice: Archive seeded public history in the persistent backend database
decisions.reason: The local seed stores canonical public activity before validators prune it. New session watches reattach only matching network/fingerprint/address/start records; watch ownership and credentials remain session scoped. The fixture archive has no HTTP credential and does not sign.

decisions.choice: Select the project Node runtime through pnpm useNodeVersion
decisions.reason: The user terminal defaults to Node 22.23.1, while the application requires Node 24. Pin 24.22.3 in pnpm-workspace.yaml to make project commands select the supported runtime automatically; retain .nvmrc for optional nvm use without changing the global Node default. Verified from the Node-22 terminal.
